name: project-fish
description: Only the tools in tools/ use this. The game itself needs no install or build step.

scripts.build-pistol: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_pistol.py -- build/arm-base/pistol.json build/pistol-raw.glb --blend build/pistol.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/pistol-raw.glb assets/pistol.glb --level high
scripts.build-arms: npm run export-arm-base && mkdir -p assets && blender --background --python tools/blender/build_arms.py -- build/arm-base build/arms-raw.glb --blend build/arms.blend && gltf-transform meshopt build/arms-raw.glb assets/arms.glb --level high
scripts.build-models: npm run build-pistol && npm run build-arms
